briefing: You look like you're new here. If you have not visited the Blacksmith already, you ought to.
I hear you.
There is a limit to how long you can wear each item. Be sure to read an item's info carefully before buying it.
Thank you for your advice.
Courtesy can pay dividends. After completing a mission, don't forget to visit one of the generals you've met.
Yes, following your plan will bring good fortune.
You can move faster by double- clicking the d-pad.
This will allow me to dash forward quickly.
The item list at the Blacksmith changes for each mission.
I ought to visit the Blacksmith after each mission to make sure I do not miss anything.
You can enchant items at the Blacksmith, but be careful. The enchantment may not work and the item could be lost.
Ah, then I should be careful when deciding what to enchant.
If you think a mission is too difficult, consider taking another path.
I suppose I can always return to complete a mission later.
You can only visit a person once after completing a mission.
If that is the case, I had better use my visits wisely.
You must save your data on the server in order to use it in LIVE mode.
That makes sense. I want to be able to duel other users in LIVE mode.
That is all you need to know for now. However, if you return later, I will continue to advise you.
Thank you.
Try to broach new topics during your visits to the generals you have met.
By broadening my conversations, I may be able to learn more.
Once you have engaged an enemy, you must fight until you eliminate him or her, or die trying.
Very well. No one who crosses my path will live to tell the story.
The path you choose during a mission will determine which enemies you face.
I see. If I am clever, I can avoid enemies that I am not yet skilled enough to vanquish.
The bigger the battlefield, the more available routes. Choose your route wisely.
I will try different routes if need be.
If you encounter a particular warrior as an enemy, don't expect to easily befriend him later on.
I must choose my encounters carefully.
Countless items are available in the field, in addition to the ones you can buy at the Blacksmith.
Yes, these items you speak of are only available while fighting in a mission.
The fame and EXP you save on the server will make you a stronger warrior.
Indeed. I will have to connect to the server to gain strength.
You can trade items with other users in LIVE mode.
Trading wisely will provide me with a huge advantage.
Accepting missions in LIVE mode will improve your chances when you face a strong enemy.
Ah, so playing in LIVE mode will definitely make me more powerful.
It's possible to acquire very rare items during LIVE mode missions.
Yes, and doing so will increase my fame and gold, as well.
Visit as many generals as you can. Visiting them is said to bring good fortune.
I have also heard that they can teach me skills and provide me with enchantments.
It's wise to visit all of the generals on your list.
Does that mean I will be at a disadvantage if I only visit occasionally?
The faster you complete a mission, the more EXP you will earn.
I must strike swiftly!
Kill enemy archers as soon as possible. It will make your missions easier.
Plus, clearing the archers from the field will earn me extra EXP.
You can move your items from here to the server by using the safe and the warehouse in LIVE mode.
It seems that I can store up to 100 items on the server.
Your chosen path will lead you to your fate.You must choose wisely!
Fate rewards the bold!
If you decide to delete or upgrade POW, always save your character and move your gold and items to the server.
That makes sense. Doing so will allow me to upgrade the game without losing my progress.
If you feel like the action is not quick enough for you, try changing the speed setting.
I ought to try that. A different speed may be more to my liking.
map: Who are you?
It matters not. Draw your weapon!
A new face. Identify yourself!
Step to the side and yield, or face my sword!
You!
I warn you: Stand down, or I will engage you!
Have we met before? Who are you?
Defend yourself!
Tell me your name!
RAHHH!
Do I know you?
As you wish. We will speak with swords!
You... ?
No need to ask!
& is here!!!
Come on!
I am &!
You are nothing but an uncivilized boor! Die!
I am. And who are you?
My name is irrelevant. Talk is cheap. Prepare to die!
May the greater warrior be victorious!
I am &.
A true warrior speaks only with his sword.
Ha! Well said!
I am &. And you are...?
Ach, what a shame. I am sorry to see you here.
Steel yourself for combat!
How could you draw your sword against me,&?
You should not be here. This is all wrong, but I must fulfill my duty.
Ha... you are not my better!
Impossible! Why would you wish to fight me,&?
Blame these horrid times.
Our fate rests with our swords...
Raising our hands against one another will only bring woe upon us. How could I be issued such a divine test as this, &...
Fate is indeed cruel, but I know what I must do.
Alas! It will pain me greatly to kill you, brother.
general: Not bad, warrior. Not bad at all.
You ought to come and visit me sometime.
Not a talkative one, eh? We will meet again soon, I think...
You are even better than I had heard.
Allow me to buy you an ale sometime.
Heed my words, and stop by soon.
Your skill is noteworthy!
Come visit me for an ale, and we will chat.
I see that you are the silent type. Please, consider my invitation, and farewell for now.
It is a very good thing you are on our side!
Until next time, warrior!
Hmm...
If you would like to visit me, you are welcome at my home anytime.
It is wonderful to see you again.
I beseech you to come share my drink! I look forward to your company.
Hmm...
Godspeed, warrior.
You are truly a great warrior!
Thank you.
It would be an honor to share a drink with you.
Hmm...
Haha... think about it. Until then, farewell!
This is a great honor!.
No, the honor is mine.
You would do me a boon to visit me at my home.
I thank you for your warm welcome.
See you then!
Very impressive! There are only a few that fight with your valor.
More than can leadwarriors as you do, General.
Please grant me the honor of sharing an ale with you.
Yes, absolutely.
I will be waiting.
You fight like a god, hero!
Thank you for your kind words.
Please, I beseech you. You must visit me for a drink.
Cheers to that!
I look forward to seeing you, then.
You are a living legend��
Nay, I am but a humble warrior.
Nonsense. You must visit my home as a guest of honor.
The honor would be all mine.
Excellent! I will see you then, brother.
